raw_content:
id: vuln-dectalk-tts-3600d8ac
languages: ["typescript"]
severity: ERROR
message: "The URL used in the dectalk function is insecure. It should use the https protocol."
metadata:
  cve: CVE-2024-31206
  cwe:
  - "300"
  - "319"
  - "598"
pattern: >
  call
  where
    call.callee.property.name = "URL"
    call.arguments[0].value starts "http://tts.cyzon.us/tts"
  select
    call.arguments[0].value
  labelled
    url as "The insecure URL"
  if
    url.value starts "http://tts.cyzon.us/tts"
  then
    severity: ERROR
  else
    severity: INFO
